rule: Band lifted, but the goal is SLOW recovery (Kiley, 2026-10-10), so the shape is the opposite of a one-day swing: few picks, entered by resting limit rather than crossing the spread. Sides still dealt by seed so nothing is quietly tilted.
seed: 20261010 (sha256 of seed|market_slug; shuffles the deal order)
note: No edge is claimed. At zero edge this is still -$3.48 a pick resting at mid, so it slows the bleed rather than reversing it -- the honest arithmetic is that 1.74 points of real edge are needed at mid and I have measured 0 over 320 picks. What this DOES do is stop paying $0.95 a pick to cross, and make an unfilled order cost nothing at all.

research.why_not_longshots: An earlier version of today's card was 4 NHL longshots at 11-15c, built for a one-day recovery swing. Wrong shape for a slow goal and replaced. Keeping the finding: at zero edge, favourites recover $1,033 only 3.4% of the time over 30 days because the payout cannot cover the hole, coin flips 29.7%, longshots 52.2% -- but longshots also carry a 20.1% chance of being $3,000 down, which is a one-shot bet on variance, not slow accumulation.
research.time_needs_an_edge: Simulated 8,000 seasons per horizon. At ZERO edge the median end goes -161, -521, -1043, -2085, -5002 at 15/30/60/120/240 days: time makes a negative-expectation loss MORE certain, not less. With a real +2.5 point edge the same horizons give +39, +279, +557, +915, +1830. So 'slowly over time' is the right plan if and only if there is an edge. The 'ever reached +1033' figure rises with time even at zero edge, but that is a random walk touching a level on the way down, not recovery.
research.spread_capture_is_real_but_small: Crossing costs $4.43/100 of EV, mid $3.48, bid $2.50. Not crossing recovers roughly half a point of break-even. It does NOT flip the sign: even filled at the bid with zero edge every pick loses $2.50.
research.the_one_open_question: The fee IS the loss -- $1,089.75 of fees against +$56.89 gross over 320 picks -- and it is modelled from the 0.0695 coefficient, never verified. The venue serves no fee schedule (/v1/fees is 404). One real fill from Kiley's own account would settle the single biggest line item in this exercise.

claude.basis: resting limit at mid -- no edge claimed
claude.rung_why: Posted at MID as a resting limit, not crossed. Measured: crossing a coin flip costs $4.43 of EV per $100 at zero edge, resting at mid $3.48, at the bid $2.50 -- so not crossing is worth about half a point of break-even (52.24% -> 51.74%). Mid rather than the bid because fillsim.py found bid fills adversely selected (24/51 = 47.1% against 50.8% for the unfilled) while mid fills hit 51.8%: a deeper limit only fills when the price has moved further against you. If nobody sells into it before kickoff this is NO BET -- no stake, no fee, excluded from the P&L by fills.py.
